parsed_json.up: Retrieve IC50 activity records for CHEMBL3338195 and all its salt forms against the HepG2 cell line target (CHEMBL395). Include provenance information (PubMed/DOI) and compound structures. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Filter for activities where the standard type is IC50. Order the results by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
